# ToUpper

Converts text to upper case.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
ToUpper(text)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to convert. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |

## Returns

String. The text with each letter in upper case, one character for one character, by the simple case mappings of Unicode version 15. Never null.

## Example

`ToUpper("ok")` returns `"OK"`.
